release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.25

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

Add Files and Clear are at the top of Assets. Specs, renumber, and Print are at the bottom.

Page controls use two rows. All sits beside None, then Odd and Even. Select by spec sits beside Sizes, and Invert is last. Odd and Even no longer say Front or Back. Color, Crop, and Bleed/Box show an icon. Those buttons, and the selection buttons, stay inactive until a document is loaded.

Page Geometry / Box Settings is at the top of the Bleed/Box window. Growing a bleed does not change that box choice.

Copying a page and pasting it in the same document duplicates the page. The original stays. Cut and paste still moves the page.
